# Interior rear panels removal and access

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove back seats, unbolt side seat belts if obstructing, take out rear cargo floor cover and piece near hatch. [t444]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the back seats to expose the bottom area.
2. [Partial] Unbolt the side seat belts if they obstruct removal.
3. [Partial] Take out the rear cargo floor cover and the piece near the hatch.
4. [Partial] Remove the underneath storage bin to clear access areas.

_Procedure reported by [t444]._

## Tools

- Long flat tip screwdriver [t444]
- [Partial] 10 mm socket or wrench [t444]

## Tips & gotchas

- Start at the rear hatch and work forward, disconnecting one attachment point at a time. [t444]
- Use patience to avoid forcing clips that might break. [t444]
